Description
Furnished 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit in this well-laid-out, spacious unit with panoramic views of Stanley Park, Coal Harbour, the water, and the North Shore Mountains from the living room, both bedrooms, and the balcony. It features luxury finishes, air conditioning, gas fire place and heated bathroom floors, all in a highly exclusive setting in an exceptional location . Laguna Parkside offers everything you need with the highest quality in every detail. 2 parking stalls included with rent! Brand New Fridge, Washer, and Dryer. Hydro and Internet are not included in the rent. **Any storage locker and parking stall measurement/size to be verified by prospective tenants if applicable.**
